idea-plugin.name: CCoder (Claude Code Assistant)
idea-plugin.description:
Runs the Claude Code CLI inside a PyCharm tool window: ask against the project you are already editing, see every file edit as a diff before it is applied, and approve or deny the commands that touch your machine.
Requires the Claude Code CLI (claude) and Node.js installed on your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.16

  • New permission mode "Auto": a classifier decides each permission prompt for you, and still asks when it is unsure. The other modes are unchanged.
  • Slash-command suggestions arrive much faster: around 0.7 s instead of 3 s.
  • Command names are no longer guessed wrong right after the plugin opens. Skills that come from a plugin (frontend-design, for example) used to be inserted without their plugin prefix.
  • The permission mode now shows what is really running: if the CLI ends up in a different mode because of settings or your plan, the panel says so and corrects the label instead of showing what you picked.
  • File completion (@) is fuzzy now: cmprk finds ComposerMode.kt. Prefix matches still come first.
  • The characters you typed are in bold in the completion list, and symbol completion (#) is fuzzy too.
  • Plan approvals (ExitPlanMode) are laid out as Markdown now: headings, lists and code blocks read as such instead of showing the raw markup.
  • "Add file to chat" in the Project view context menu works again — it was greyed out on files.
  • The session library is no longer empty for projects opened through a mapped drive (Z:) — the list matches what the CLI sees.
  • The permission and plan dialogs are wider and can be resized, and their inline code and section headings are readable in dark themes.

中文

  • 权限模式多了一个「自动判定」：由模型逐条判定放不放行，拿不准的仍会询问。其余模式不变。
  • 打 / 的候选来得快多了：3 秒变成 0.7 秒左右。
  • 刚打开插件那几秒里，命令名不再猜错 —— 来自插件的技能（比如 frontend-design）此前会被写成不带插件前缀的名字。
  • 权限模式现在会显示真正在跑的那个：CLI 若因设置或订阅档换成了别的模式，界面会说一句并改过来，而不是一直显示你选的那个。
  • @ 补全支持模糊匹配：cmprk 也能找到 ComposerMode.kt。前缀命中的仍排在最前。
  • 补全列表里，你敲的那几个字符会加粗；# 符号补全同样支持模糊匹配。
  • 计划审批框（ExitPlanMode）现在按 Markdown 排版：标题、列表、代码块都成形，不再把 #、** 当源码显示。
  • 项目树右键的「添加文件到聊天」恢复可用 —— 此前在文件上是灰的，点不动。
  • 用映射盘（Z:）打开的项目，会话库的历史列表不再恒为空 —— 看到的就是 CLI 那边那些。
  • 权限与计划框更宽、可拉伸；里面的行内代码与小节标题在深色主题下也读得清。
